headline: Rising US Inflation Expectations Signal Further Federal Reserve Rate Hikes
summary: Accelerating inflation data for October has increased expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates at its next meeting. The Fed continues to monitor these metrics to influence borrowing costs.
why: The Federal Reserve uses interest rates to manage inflation. Higher rates increase borrowing costs for businesses and consumers, typically acting as a headwind for equity markets and bond prices.

impacts.name: US Federal Funds Rate
impacts.why: Persistent inflation forces the central bank to tighten monetary policy to cool the economy.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Market participants adjust expectations for future borrowing costs based on inflation data, directly impacting bond yields and equity valuations.
